title: 2.8 Uses of Microorganisms
description: Food, industrial, medical and environmental applications of microbes. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which term matches this description? Microbial metabolism used to produce foods and chemicals
Which term matches this description? A dairy food made by bacterial fermentation of milk
Which term matches this description? A dairy product formed by curdling milk with microbes and rennet
Which term matches this description? Using yeast to produce carbon dioxide that raises dough
Which term matches this description? Using yeast to convert sugars into alcohol and carbon dioxide
Which term matches this description? A sour liquid made by bacteria oxidising ethanol
Which term matches this description? A compound produced by microbes that inhibits other microbes
Which term matches this description? Microbes used to make industrial enzymes such as amylase
Which term matches this description? A chemical such as citric acid made by microbial fermentation
Which term matches this description? Cultivating microbes to produce materials used in vaccines
Which term matches this description? A fuel made from biological material such as crops or algae
Which term matches this description? A methane-rich fuel made by anaerobic digestion of waste
Which term matches this description? Using microbes to decompose organic waste into humus
Which term matches this description? The use of microorganisms to remove pollutants from the environment
Which term matches this description? Using microbes to break down organic matter in sewage
Which term matches this description? The use of microorganisms to extract metals from low-grade ores
Which term matches this description? A food containing live microbes that benefit health
Which term matches this description? Protein produced from cultured microbes for food or feed
Which term matches this description? A device that uses microbes to detect specific chemicals
Which term matches this description? A microbial preparation used to control agricultural pests
